balls.text: Low fully outside off, square driven to deep point. They take two, throw goes to the keeper, who throws it to the bowler. Siraj is blinded and takes off, only to get run out. Fair enough though, better get out looking for an extra run than not go at all

Yorker nailed, Green squirts it to long-on. Karn has to go back for two and sacrifices his wicket. Line of the ball was around fifth, Green swooshed and got it along the ground, throw was good and at the bowler did the rest

Dances down, reaches out and misses the wide yorker. Fair ball called, Green reviews. This is tricky but the third umpire has no qualms staying with the on-field call. Green's reach works against him. He was running straight and the ball seemed to be just outside the tramline - within his reach though. Green not happy and has a word with the ump but has to go back and carry on
Yorker has been nutmegged to short 45, Green will farm strike this time. Was a cross-seam yorker on fifth stump, maybe followed Green who was sliding across.
Heaves, misses and sneaks a bye. Good desperate running from both batters, throw from the keeper doesn't hit the stumps. Was an into-the-pitch slower one just outside off that beat the pull
He falters and Karn capitalises. The cutter into the pitch is wide and angling away, there was no one outside the ring at third, and Karn elevated it well

Finishes with a perfect yorker, Rasikh has been brilliant at the death. This was at the stumps and is jammed to long-on. Wonder if the batters could've decided not to take the single but they do. Karn on strike for the last
Yorker on fifth, 135ks, he's nailin em. Jammed to cover
Length ball has been worked down the ground

Picks it up around the corner, holes out to deep-backward square. He gets rewarded after going in the pitch, probably slow too, and at the body. Swapnil was on the back foot and looked to helped it finer
Wide and full, past the tramline. RCB get a wide Rasikh is pumped.
Nails the yorker on off. Green is deep in the crease but all he can do is jam it close to his feet. Sneaks a single
Full and slow, tries to smack it over long-off. Gets beaten

Khaleel has DK for a duck, silence in the crowd! Was a wide ball into the pitch, Karthik went deep in the crease and cut it hard but hit it straight to backward point. Khaleel gets a chance to probably vent out the pent-up frustration. Pumps his wrists and roars wildly
Yes, for a start. Crowd goes ooo. Was a fullish ball angling outside off, DK tried thrashing it through cover

Porel runs back, almost overruns it, has to get his hands back after starting in front of the body, ends up taking it above his head. Khaleel breathes a long sigh of relief. He finished just outside the ring and cleared ground with a couple of nearby fielders coming in. Was a fullish length ball around the stumps that Lomror wanted to pick up across the line
Length on sixth, there for the same shot, but he carves it straight to the sweeper
Green gets his weight into the belting cover drive. Huge reach too, his body coiled back after pumping the full, wide ball through wide long-off
Tad back of length just outside off, tries to square drive it off the back foot. Misses
Slog swept over midwicket, 22 off the over and RCB are reviving the innings. This was too full and too straight, Lomror got on one knee and hammered it.
Green doesn't know where it's gone but the ball lands safely, around where first slip would've been, and rolls to short third. He tried to sweep a length ball, looked to have gone off the gloves
Flat on a length at leg, clears the front leg and works it between midwicket and long-on. Latter runs in and throws swiftly but not early enough to cut off two
Seamer Kuldeep gets met by Green. Dug in short with miltary-medium pace, Green pulls it over cow corner
RCB's 150 is up. Looped up and it's clubbed over long-off. Green was probably waiting for a full ball that he could step hit since he came in. Got towards the pitch and creamed it through the line
Wide and full, slapped on the bounce to long-off
Length ball sits up, slapped from sixth stump to the left of deep point. Spins to the right late but Rasikh manages to change direction and stop it. 119ks. Timeout
Low fully at the stumps, driven to long-on. Green lunging low is quite a sight btw
Wide on a length, slapped to deep point
Down leg this time. 138ks, too full, Lomror missed out on whipping it through the leg side
Bumper is well directed but a bit too high, ducked under. Wide picked up

Hit and run to mid-off, Stubbs can't get the direct hit at the non-striker's end. He picked it up and yanked it with so much power he fell down, Green's long strides would've taken him through though, replays confirm. Was a full ball that was driven to the left of mid-off
Length on fourth, slapped to deep third's right
Length over off, 139ks, guided to deep third
Spin for Kuldeep to beat bat. Green tried to run it through the off side and got beaten
Full just outside off, smother-flicked to long-on

Jacks, like Patidar, hits out to cover. Axar making more amends there! The ball was bulleting at his thighs. His feet glued but acted as a cushion after the ball stuck. This was a slowish googly on a length that sat up. Jacks made room and went hard, couldn't nail it or place it well enough
Length on fourth, slapped to long-off
Length on fourth, lot of air given, seemed to go straight and get a bit of extra bounce. Topspinner maybe. Cut back to the bowler
Starts okay. Length on leg, clipped towards deep midwicket for two
Length on fourth, punched through cover for one. Just three off the over. Super from Axar
Makes room and slaps the fullish length ball outside off to the left of long-off
Jacks swings himself out of reach and shape. He cleared the front leg and swivelled further as the length ball spun away to go just outside off. Beaten
Length on fourth, cut hard to cover. Goes on the bounce. Good bounce for Axar. 97ks
Length outside off, punched to long-on
Tossed up (as much as Axar can) on a length outside off, gets a bit of turn away to beat the flourishing cover drive
Flat-bat bash not middled but lands safely, long-on runs to the left and keeps it to two

Excellent from Jacks, keeps going despite the wicket. Length ball outside off, was thrashed to the right of deep point. Mukesh covered most of the distance but decided to stop it with his feet. Can't do it
Works it to the leg side

Clother, Axar finally hangs onto one. Patidar's adventure runs out of luck! Axar had to run to the right again, this time he timed his jump better, probably went for it after getting closer to the ball. Took it with both hands. Was a hard-length ball to which Patidar tried flat-batting. Didn't get enough room, staying put in the crease didn't help
Tries the same ball with pace on, gets it a bit too wide. Let go to collect wide. Length was better fwiw
Low, slow and wide. The full cutter is just inside the tramline and is swiped to long-off
Slot ball just outside off, 137ks, Patidar lunges back and slaps to long-off
Slow on the fuller side of length, tries to slap it through cover. Underedges it towards long-off
Length on fifth, 131ks, sits up well for the on-the-up slap. Goes flat in the air, over the infield, but deep point is able to cut it off
Lack of bounce, at least it was lower than what Jacks expected. He made room and tried to mow the fullish ball outside off, over long-on. Underedged it onto the grass, then to the keeper
Extra bounce off a length beats bat. 128ks, lands in line with the stumps and goes over fourth, Jacks tried carving it over cover
Tries to thrash the fullish ball over cover. Beaten
Fullish outside off, driven to the sweeper. Patidar raises fifty, bat goes up. Fans applaud unanimously, atmosphere is great
Yorker attempt ends up as a full toss at the knee-roll, easy for Jacks to help it along with fine leg in the ring.
Goes for the wide yorker this time. It's just outside the tramline this time, given wide
Wide on a back of a length, the cutter spins back in a bit and is let go. Came back enough to be inside the tramline
Low fully on middle, whipped to deep midwicket
Good slower one. No pace off the pitch, bunted with the cross-bat to the off side
Fullish just outside off, tries slapping it. Gets it off the inside-half of the bat to long-on

Another drop! It's Axar again, he salmon-dived to the left at cover and tried taking it goalkeeper style. Ball pops between the fingers again. He yells in frustration. Was a fullish ball outside off and Patidar didn't check the cover drive, got it on the up. Ball may have stuck in the pitch a bit.
Wide on a length, guided to deep third
Slashes a knee-roll high full toss at the stumps, to deep point

Stubbs backtracks from cover and ends up not making contact with the skier! He ran from the edge of the ring, was going to the diagonal left and got the right hand out in the last second. Matt Hayden says he panicked. Was a cutter short into the pitch, Jacks made room and tried to chomp it over the off side again
Makes room and flays it over extra cover! The length ball seemed to have been going over the stumps
Slapped off a length. Not much room and it raced along the ground. Was going in Axar's direction at cover, but he could only half-stop it. That's minus one in the fielding analysis
Another edge from Patidar's pull lands safely behind the wicket. Back of length outside off, he tried to drag it square on the leg side.
Goes the other way to beat bat. Length ball lands around middle and off and Jacks tried to work it legside. Got beaten all ends up. Timeout

Seam-up ball creates another chance in the over, Hope shells it at long-on though! He went to the right, got behind the ball, and tried to take it while balancing on one knee. Got hands on it but ball popped out. Was a seamer's length ball around leg, Patidar got leg side of the ball but couldn't make enough room to nail the pull. The drop creates a big pop from the crowd, including Anushka Sharma, who's in
Wide on a length, slides away further to finish wide. Let go
Slog swept into the ground, goes square of the wicket and is stopped in the deep

Googly has been skied, Axar running back towards mid-on, tries to take it on the move but the ball bursts through the fingers! Was pitched up and on the slower side, Jacks tried to smoke it across the line and got it right up
Kuldeep gives it air and gets pumped. It actually got good drift away and was a bit too full, Jacks slog swept it with the cleanest of swings
Seam-up? Might've been - 114ks. Fullish length for a seamer, and on the pads, clipped to midwicket
Length outside off, guided to cover
Slingier again but Patidar punished it mercilessly. A bit short and he cleared the front leg out of town, got square-on and pulled it far over midwicket
Shortish and wide, slapped to long-off. Axar slingier with the action there
Goes back and tucks the length ball on top of middle, towards wide long-on
Length around off, steered off the back foot towards cover point
Length just outside off, guided towards deep third. Seemed like there was extra bounce
Full and flat on middle an doff, pushed to wide long-on
Length at the stumps, worked off the back foot to long-on
RCB not allowing Kuldeep to go full. Jacks enjoys a step-hit this time. Whacks it from around off for another six over long-on
Length at the stumps, worked towards midwicket
Boshed through the line. Too full from Kuldeep, step-hit for Patidar. Bat-swing is free and Porel had to lower the call of 'catch it' right away
Spins in sharply to cramp him on the cut. Patidar stood in front of leg and ended up getting off the sticker. Ball landed well outside off and finished around middle
On the up, inside out through cover. Jacks picks up two more
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Slogs a length ball from outside off over midwicket! Patidar made room and reached out a bit but held his balance really well
Length on leg, clipped to backward square leg
Length on middle and leg, stays legside and punches to extra cover
Length around off, defended to cover
Full outside off, pushed to cover

RCB are T20ing beautifully. The loss of early wickets isn't stopping Patidar from looking for boundaries. He either expected the length to be a tad short or read it real early, pulled it in front of square with ease
Some gorgeous shots today so far and that's in the top three. Pumped through cover again. Picked up off a fullish length just outside off through cover

Patidar top edges the pull, Porel runs right back but can't reach it! Was an outswinger on a hard length just outside off, Patidar tried muscling it square. Porel covered a few metres but didn't get close. Manages to reach after it landed and save two
Tries to clip the hard-length ball to the legside, beats the back-foot flick with the closed face. Hits the body and falls in front
Patidar holds his shape this time. Fullish ball around fourth, he takes a small stride towards the line, keeps his upper body firm and shows the full face.
Length on fourth, worked to midwicket to end my favourite over of the tournament so far
Length on fourth, defended in front

Ishant, you beauty! Dude's beaten and nicked off Kohli after being pumped. He has a somewhat jovial word while leaping about in celebration, gives him a jovial tug, which Kohli accepts with head down and a wry smile. It was a length ball on fourth, swung away just a bit and Kohli's feet went nowhere as he tried to slash the cover off it. But all he could manage was a tickle that popped the ball to the keeper
Makes room and gets followed. The length ball slips out wide down leg. Let go
And Ishant shows why he's so good, beats bat with skill! Holds onto a perfect length, line's just outside off. Kohli opens the face and tries to work it to the off side. Gets beaten

Overpitched and that's been flogged with authority! No-look too, Kohli almost treating Ishant like a clubbie. It was a slot ball at the stumps, no movement. That's what aided him smoke it over wide long-on
No slip and that's where it goes! Kohli has a word with Ishant, almost like he's picking a fight.
Length at the stumps, defended in front
Kohli charges and Mukesh bangs it on a hard length to deny the batter the chance to get under it. It's worked off the back foot, with a little adjustment due to lack of room, to deep square leg
Length on leg, beats the flick and goes off the pad in front. Kohli lobs the ball to Mukesh, who's running in. The bowler cheekily pretends to throw it back at the stumps
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third

Faf falls into the trap DC set at deep backward point! Mukesh goes wide and swings the ball further away and Faf tried to drive over cover. But it went flat off the bottom of the bat, straight to the JFM. Mukesh has hands high. Hayden says Faf tried to replicate Kohli's shot from last over but his hands came around the ball and reduced the chances of middling it
Wide on a fullish length, tries to carve it hard, misses

That's why Kohli gets paid the big bucks, holds the shape on an extra cover drive on the up to show off his artistry. Showed the full face of the bat to a rising length ball. The entire body seemed to be in balance as he made contact, it travels 76 metres far
Swings in late to get the edge. Was very full and the swing had it pitch just outside leg, inside edges a flick to the leg side
Just fuller than a good length and on fourth stump, dabbed off the back foot to deep third
Change of line, on leg stump now. Beats the flick and deflects off the thigh pad towards square leg
Faf uses the width and slaps it hard this time, through cover for four. He stood upright and the length ball sat up too. Hand-eye coordination took over
No swing first up but the angle away is sharp. Three-quarter length ball around fifth, gently slapped to cover. Off the back foot
Kohli does get Ishant away, ruins an otherwise excellent first over. Not that short but it was angling in at him and he pulled it from close to the body for a flat six over forward square leg

Two stolen to midwicket, ball went halfway into the outfield and Mukesh ran to the right from mid-on. Batters hared for two. Was a length ball in the channel that was worked off the back foot, ball hit the sticker as the bat-face closed. The timing was reduced but that allowed time for the second
Kohli's counterattack can't get Ishant away, just too much bounce. There's a bit of width and he made room while charging, but the ball went over the edge as he tried to slash it square

Ishant's enjoying the assistance in the air and off the deck. Goes good length again, 135ks, starts at a wide-ish line and hoops it in towards fifth. Faf, too, checks the flat-bat bunt. Steers it to deep point
Kohli tries to cut down the movement by dancing down, sees he has a bit of room. The flat-bat had to be checked because of the bounce, ball hits the sticker and steers to deep third

Swings in sharply to hit the sticker of the bat, inside-half too and Kohli's bottom hand came off as he tried defending close to the body. Good length and an off-stump line too. Great start from Ishant
Cleaned up! DC fold for 140. Full length delivery on middle and off, Kuldeep moves away to hit, exposes his stumps and fails to connect
Fuller on middle stump, knocks it down to off side gently
Length delivery on middle and leg, Ishant can't  reach
Too full and going down the leg
Yorker on middle and off, drilled to cover for a run
Full length and wide of off, driven to mid-off
Full length delivery outside off, moving away, Kuldeep can't connect
pace off, too full and wide of off
Pushed to deep extra cover for two
140kmph, bangs in a bouncer, Ishant can't connect
Full outside off, looks to drive towards cover, gets an inside edge
Nine down! Ferguson bowls another short delivery, Mukesh tries to hit this across the line, it goes up in the air, Lomror takes a few steps backwards from midwicket and takes the catch
Goes for a swing and he misses
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kuldeep moves across and pulls this away to deep backward square leg
Short of a length delivery, lofts this over mid-on for one
Fuller on middle stump, pushed to cover
Short delivery outside off, puts it away to mid-off
Short delivery from outside off, Mukesh can't connect
Fires in a bounce, too short, wide signalled
Full length delivery on off stump, 136kmph, defended awkwardly
Full length delivery outside off, pulled away to square leg
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, knocks back to bowler
Too full and wide of off, slower delivery, taps it to point
Pushed to long-on for a run

Axar's innings comes to an end! Pace off, too full and wide of off stump, Axar drags this towards cover-point, a thick outside edge from a mishit, Faf runs backwards and completes the catch, rolling down the ground
Another slower delivery. Too full but Axar has moved away. It's not a wide
Full length outside off, cuts away to backward point
Pace off. Full toss, he looks to pull this away. can't connect. Gets hit on right thigh but he is okay

Holes out to long-on! Length delivery on the middle and off stump, pace off from Green, Rasikh looks to go big, but the ball only goes high up in the air. Jacks completes an easy catch at long-on to leave DC seven down
full length on the middle stump, just opens the face of the bat to place it towards deep third for a run
short of a length delivery on the hips, tucked away to deep square leg
Full length outside off, he comes down the track, a wild swing and a miss
127kmph, full length outside off, he moves across to smash this over leg side but another mishit. It falls safely in the vacant short midwicket region
Full length delivery outside leg, he shuffles a bit and looks to pull this away. Can't connect properly
Pace off. Fuller on off stump, pushed to cover
Fuller on leg, 144.5kmph, flicked away to deep backward square leg
Short of a length delivery outside off, taps it to right of deep third
Length delivery on the hips, taps gently to midwicket and takes a run
Short of a length delivery, pulled away to deep backward square leg
144.6kmph, charges down to a full ball outside off, and hits this towards deep point. Siraj collects the ball near rope but his leg touches the boundary line. That will be four
50 for Axar! Full ball outside off, he goes down on one knee and whacks this high over long-on fence. Gets his second fifty of this IPL
Fuller outside off stump, guided to deep point
Driven to long-on for a run
Comes down the track to a full ball outside off and slices this to deep cover
Drilled to deep point for a single
Just clears the rope! Full on off, turning away, he goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps this over deep midwicket
Fuller on stumps, knocks it back to bowler
Fuller on the middle, goes back and taps this to square leg
Full and outside off, lofts this over deep over for two runs
Wow, that's huge! Full on stumps, gets done on one knee and puts this away to leg side for an 80m-six
Pushed to extra cover for a run

Hugeeeee wicket! What's happening DC? Length ball outside leg, he shuffles across, gets an inside edge. Stubbs wants a quick run and off he goes, but Axar is still in the crease at striker's end. Green quickly picks up the ball and fires in a throw and he is gone. Axar never said yes to the run. RCB well in control of the chase at the moment
Back of a length delivery, taps it to straight to Kohli at backward point
Short of a length delivery on leg and middle stump, jams it down to point
Full delivery outside off stump, looks to push forward, gets an outside edge to deep third
Full length delivery on the stumps, drilled to deep point
Short ball outside off, guided to deep third for a single
Full delivery on middle stump, driven to long-on to get off of the mark
Knocked back to bowler

Excellent running catch from Karn! Full toss outside off, Hope looks to smash this towards leg side  but doesn't time it well. Karn runs in from deep midwicket, covers a fair bit of ground, and takes a brilliant diving catch. Avoid collision with Lomror who came in from mid-on
Full length delivery on off stump, taps it to deep backward point
Length delivery angling in, uses the pace to guide this towards deep third for four
Full length delivery on off stump, punched to covers
125kmph, too short, wide signalled
Fifty stand! Length delivery on the stumps, pulled away to deep backward square leg
Slightly full outside off stump angling in, bit of bounce there, surprises Hope
Full length delivery on leg stump, outside edges to off side
Comes down the track to a length delivery outside off, tries to hit this across the line and gets an outside edge to deep point
Crisp! Full length delivery just outside off, he lofts this to right of mid-on for four
Length ball angling in, looks to flick but can't connect. It rolls off the pad
Fuller outside off, pace off, gets a thick outside edge to right of deep third
Excellent chase by Swapnil to stop the boundary. Full length delivery on the stumps, flicked away to deep midwicket region
Full length delivery on the stumps, 144.9mph, taps it to point and takes a quick single. Kohli fires in a throw but Axar is safe
148kmph, Fuller outside off, driven straight to cover
Full delivery outside off stump, driven down the ground to deep cover for two
Too short outside off, Axar pulls this away to deep midwicket for four
Full outside off, turning away, he goes back and punches this to deep cover
Just short of long-on! Full outside off, he comes down the track and heaves it to leg side
Full outside off, pushed to left of long-off
Fuller on middle stump, flicked away to leg side for a quick single
Punched down the ground to long-off for a single
Nice! Full length delivery outside off stump, he lofts this to left of mid-off to end the powerplay with four
Full on middle stump, knocked back to bowler

Misfield from Swapnil. Length delivery on of off stump, driven towards cover-point for two. Swapnil had just come inside the ring before the ball was delivered and Kohli wasn't happy with the misfield
Full length delivery on middle stump, hit back to bowler
Found the gap! Slightly short outside off, uses the pace to place this towards deep point for four
142.7kmph, length delivery angling in to Hope, pushed towards short third
Full length delivery on middle stump, keeps it to backward point
Full length delivery on middle and leg stump, defended to off side
Too full and outside off, Hope shows off his class by placing this in the gap between cover-point and cover for another boundary
Pure timing, again! back of a length delivery on leg stump, flicked away to deep square for four
Full length delivery on the stumps, driven straight to Faf at mid-off
Nice! Full delivery outside off, clears his front leg and plays a beautiful cover drive. Great timing on this one
Yorker outside off, digs it out to point. Just two runs from the over
Bangs in a bouncer, he can't reach
Full delivery outside off, pushed to covers

Siraj gets his first and DC are four down inside the powerplay! Big moment in the game. Full length delivery from outside off, swinging in and pace on, he looks to push and misses. Ball straightens a bit and hits his front pad. Umpire's finger goes up. It looks plumb and DC don't want to review this.
Slightly full length on the stumps, defended
Length delivery on the stumps, flicked away to deep square for two
Full length delivery outside off, shaping away from Hope, lets it go
Length delivery on the middle, nudged to mid-on
Back of a length delivery on the hips, goes for a backfoot punch. Gets an outside edge to deep third for four
Full and outside off, beaten for outside edge

RCB are celebrating! What an over this is turning out to be. Length ball on the stumps, Hope hits it straight down the ground, Dayal gets his left hand on it and it deflects off to the stumps at the non-striker's end. Fraser-McGurk, who was not inside the crease, has to depart. So unfortunate!
Wicket off the first ball! Yash Dayal strikes straightaway. Starts with a short ball on off, rushed into Porel, he looks to hit this across the line but top-edges it to Ferguson at cover
Another boundary! Back of a length delivery, he moves away a bit to create room and punches this towards sweeper cover for four
Thick outside edge! Low full toss outside off, he looks to hit this towards off side and it comes off a thick edge and runs off to deep third for four
Goes for a wild swing and misses
Punished! Full length delivery on the middle stump, he hits it straight over the bowler's head for six. Not a perfectly timed shot but that's okay
Length ball on the stumps, defended on the backfoot
Starts with a brilliant yorker on the stumps. 140.4kmph. Siraj wants to review the decision for lbw. Ball comes off the toe end of the bat and goes off to right of keeper. RCB lose their review
Excellent over! Tossed up outside off, a big swing from JFM, and he misses
Full length delivery outside off, knocks it down the ground. Swapnil dives and gets his hand on it

Gone! Chinnaswamy erupts. Full length outside off, he gets down on one knee for a slog sweep only to be caught by Will Jacks at wide long-on. Swapnil gets the early breakthrough for RCB and it's the big wicket of Warner
A bit shorter, punched down the ground to wide long-off
Off the mark with six! What a player. Fuller on middle and off, gets down on one knee and smashes it high over long-off fence
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to mid-on
